raw.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Senior Backend Engineer - Case Management
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Role overview We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build and evolve our new Common case-management system, which powers support-case handling across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. You will own significant end-to-end initiatives across our backend services: case lifecycle, routing and assignment, queue management, case evidence and history, and migration from legacy systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn ambiguous customer and operational problems into durable technical solutions, coordinate other engineers, and set the standard for reliability and craftsmanship on the team. What you'll do Lead one or more project-level Case Management initiatives, on your own or by guiding a group of engineers, from discovery and design through rollout, measurement, and operational ownership. Design and build scalable backend services and APIs for case creation, routing, assignment, transfers, audit history, notes, attachments, and queue-management workflows. Help deliver feature parity with legacy platforms while safely migrating traffic across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. Make and own most technical decisions within your scope. Write project-level design documents covering how sub-features interact, identify dependencies and risks, and break work into parallelizable delivery plans. Scope ambiguous customer and operational problems, weigh long-term against short-term trade-offs, and design durable solutions. Partner with Product, Operations, Support, Data, and other engineering teams to define the right problems. Shape the team roadmap through prototypes, data analysis, project proposals, and backlog prioritization. Run the coordination a project needs, such as status updates and dependency tracking, and escalate early to keep delivery on time. Enforce team-wide quality objectives: lead design reviews, calibrate quality metrics, and improve logging, monitoring, alerting, and escalation policies. Serve as first responder or incident commander, model good incident practice, and turn what you learn into playbooks and backlog work. Introduce and guide AI best practices for the team, including evals, data privacy, and review of AI-generated code, and take part in AI-powered projects when they are central to the product. Design reusable, self-serviceable solutions, and consider cost efficiency, including compute and AI costs, in key designs. Mentor engineers through code reviews, design guidance, tech talks, and constructive feedback. Interview candidates, join sell calls, and take part in hiring events when the team needs them. Must-have qualifications Strong backend engineering experience, including designing and operating backend services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and data models at meaningful scale. Proficiency in at least one modern backend language, and a record of writing exemplary code for the core functionality of key components. Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing or operations-critical projects from technical design through production rollout. Experience breaking projects into parallelizable work, identifying dependencies and risks, and giving accurate estimates for yourself and others. Hands-on experience using AI development tools to improve productivity, while validating generated output for correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and reliability. Strong product judgment: the ability to turn ambiguous workflows and user needs into simple, maintainable technical solutions. Proven ability to collaborate across functions, bring the right stakeholders into decisions at the right time, and explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong engineering craft: testing, code review, observability, incident response, security, and operational readiness, with experience designing for reliability. Comfort working on systems with high correctness and auditability requirements, including traceability of decisions and changes. A mentoring mindset and a record of raising team-wide engineering standards. Nice-to-have qualifications Go experience. Experience with migration from legacy systems, gradual rollouts, traffic shadowing, and feature-parity programs. Experience supporting internal tools or operational user interfaces from the backend side. Experience with high-volume, multi-region, or multi-tenant systems. Experience as an incident commander or in running an on-call rotation. Experience building AI-powered features, including evaluation of model output. What success looks like Delivers a major Case Management initiative with clear technical ownership, predictable execution, and measurable customer or business impact. Improves the reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency of the Common system while enabling safe migration from legacy case-management systems. Helps move support traffic onto the Common system without reducing case-resolution quality. Builds solutions that other engineers and operators can confidently reuse and operate. Acts as a technical leader within the team: unblocks peers and partner teams, improves engineering decisions, influences the roadmap, and strengthens cross-functional execution. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness . Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Als erste Person im Account Management unseres Teams, das bisher vor allem auf Neukundengewinnung ausgerichtet ist, trägst du direkt zu unserem Wachstum bei.

Who We Want

3+ Jahre Account Management Experience.
Du hast bereits mehrere Jahre erfolgreich im Account Management eines SaaS-Unternehmens gearbeitet und kannst messbare Upsell-Erfolge vorweisen.

Relationship Builder.
Du baust Beziehungen innerhalb eines Unternehmens gezielt aus, verstehst seine Strukturen und weißt, wer welche Entscheidungen trifft.

Solution-Minded.
Du verstehst komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen und übersetzt sie in überzeugende Upgrade-Cases.

SaaS Fluency.
Du verstehst SaaS-Geschäftsmodelle in der Tiefe und weißt, wie du sie nutzt, um für deine Kund:innen den größten Mehrwert zu schaffen. Erfahrung mit HubSpot ist ein Plus.

Highly Numerate.
Du verstehst die Business-Treiber deiner Kund:innen und kannst den Impact einer Lösung mit Zahlen greifbar machen.

Structured.
Du arbeitest mit einer klaren Sales-Methodik und baust für deine Accounts durchdachte Account-Pläne auf.

Self-Starter.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für dein Segment, gehst mit hoher Energie und Fokus an deine Ziele und arbeitest dabei gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Strong communicator.
Du sprichst muttersprachliches Deutsch, verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und drückst dich schriftlich wie mündlich klar und überzeugend aus.

Who We Don’t Want

Inflexible.
Du hältst an starren Abläufen fest, statt dich auf unterschiedliche Kund:innen und neue Situationen einzustellen.

Arrogant.
Du trittst gegenüber Kund:innen oder Kolleg:innen überheblich auf, statt auf Augenhöhe zu arbeiten.

Unwilling to learn.
Du hast kein Interesse daran, dich weiterzuentwickeln, und nimmst Feedback nicht an.

Relies on the brand.
Du verlässt dich auf den Namen oder die Marktposition des Unternehmens, statt Beziehungen über echten Mehrwert aufzubauen.

Account Growth & Upsell (ca. 60%)

  • Du erstellst Account-Pläne, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und führst Gespräche bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss

Solution Design (ca. 20%)

Reporting & Revenue Management (ca. 10%)

Customer Insights (ca. 10%)

  • Du gibst Feedback zu Branchen und Use Cases, die besonders gut funktionieren, und hilfst Marketing so, künftige Zielgruppen gezielter anzusprechen

Kund:innen: deine wichtigste Ansprechgruppe - du kennst ihre Unternehmen und begleitest sie langfristig in ihrem Wachstum
Sales Team: für den Austausch zu Fortschritt, Best Practices und gemeinsamen Zielen

Product & Engineering: für Feedback zu fehlenden Features und Wachstumshürden aus Kundensicht

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

About the Advanced Technology Group

The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) is a part of Foundational Systems and Experiences Engineering (FSEE) within the Platform Business Group. Established over 20 years ago as part of PlayStation®’s first-party game development studios, ATG has always focused on helping game developers get the most out of PlayStation® hardware - a mission that continues to this day. As a team, we are responsible for large parts of the graphics software stack used by all PlayStation® games, and collaborate with leading engineering teams worldwide, from game developers to hardware vendors, to deliver key platform technologies.

What you’ll be doing

  • You will be working on Razor GPU, a GPU performance analysis and debugging tool, for current and future PlayStation® platforms.
  • You will be developing GPU Capture and Replay technology, which allows GPU commands, shaders and resources to be captured, analysed and later reinstated, so that graphics frames can be re-executed on the GPU independently from the running game.
  • You will be developing profiling and debugging features upon this core technology, to help game developers worldwide to realize their creative vision and push PlayStation® hardware to its limits.
  • You will be developing internal features used by platform software and hardware teams, to help build and improve the PlayStation® graphics software stack, as well as diagnose low-level platform issues.
  • You will collaborate with game developers and platform engineers to gain a deep understanding of their needs, with a view to creating efficient, reliable and scalable tools, which are a joy to use for new and deeply technical engineers alike.

This is a unique senior engineering role at the heart of PlayStation® GPU technology, where you will work within a highly experienced technology-driven team. We are looking for developers who are passionate about their craft, the products they build, and who would like to make a lasting impact on the PlayStation® graphics software stack, its tooling, and its future.

What we are looking for

  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to design and implement highly reliable performant systems in C++.
  • Strong debugging skills, including the ability to understand and reason about complex systems, as well as unpick their interactions.
  • Experience developing on consoles, particularly using console graphics and memory management APIs.
  • An interest in GPU architecture and low-level graphics engineering.
  • Experience using GPU profiling and debugging tools.
  • An eagerness to learn and take responsibility of features end-to-end, from building core systems, to influencing end-user UX design.

 

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

ENABLE SAFE, REUSABLE AUTOMATION

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What you'll do This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands. At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area. In this role, you will: Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results. Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land. Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments. Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current. Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own. Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases. Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched. Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure. Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams. Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice. Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them. Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends. What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs. 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions. raw.title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
raw.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

  • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

  • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

  • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

  • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

  • Clear written communication. Mapbox is distributed across time zones and we make most decisions in documents and Slack.

Nice to have traits for this role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

raw.title: Dessinateur Projeteur CAO
raw.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous concevez en CAO les pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques de nos produits, dans nos drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre quotidien est la modélisation sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks : mécanismes et pièces imprimés en 3D, intégration des composants électroniques, assemblages complets.

Vous faites évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des impressions et des essais, et vous produisez les plans, nomenclatures et documents de montage des versions validées.

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces

  • Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles

  • Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions

  • Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

  • Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables

Prototypage rapide (15 %)

  • Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes

  • Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais

Plans et documentation de production (10 %)

  • Réaliser les mises en plan et les nomenclatures des pièces et sous-ensembles validés

  • Participer à la rédaction des gammes de montage et des instructions d'assemblage

  • Participer aux modifications des schémas de câblage

Essais (5 %)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : banc, sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation et expérience

  • Bac+2/+3 (BTS CPRP ou CPI, BUT GMP, licence pro) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique ou mécatronique

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion et SolidWorks (CATIA ou d'autres)

  • Conception de mécanismes et d'assemblages

  • Règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; pratique d'OrcaSlicer ou d'un autre slicer

  • Mise en plan, cotation et tolérancement

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, câblage, soudure

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4)

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices)

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D (portfolio CAO apprécié)

  • Intérêt pour l'aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense

Qualités personnelles

  • Goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on » et la CAO "bien faite"

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe

Ponctuellement, vous intervenez sur l'intégration et le dimensionnement de l'électronique embarquée afin de valider les prototypes de bout en bout, de la modélisation aux premiers essais. Vous contribuez ensuite à la mise en production des produits validés (DFM, optimisations, gammes de montage, schémas de câblage).

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de mission : 55%)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 des pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces de charges utiles, …

  • Intégrer dès la conception les contraintes de la fabrication additive FDM : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Faire évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais (cycles d'itération courts)

  • Réaliser les assemblages, et assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

Prototypage rapide (5%)

Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction pour valider rapidement les choix techniques

  • Analyser les résultats d'essais et les retours terrain afin d'orienter les itérations suivantes

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes dans un objectif d’amélioration continue

Industrialisation et mise en production (30%)

  • Faire évoluer les prototypes validés vers une version industrialisable en appliquant les principes DFM / DFA (conception pour la fabrication et l'assemblage)

  • Optimiser les pièces et sous-ensembles : masse, coût, nombre de pièces, temps de fabrication, choix des procédés et matériaux de série

  • Participer à la rédaction les gammes de montage et les instructions d'assemblage

  • Réaliser les schémas de câblage et la documentation électrique associée

  • Constituer le dossier de définition du produit : plans, nomenclatures, tolérances

  • Participer au choix et au dimensionnement des composants embarqués (motorisation, ESC, batteries, contrôleur de vol, capteurs, câblage) selon les contraintes du prototype : masse, encombrement, consommation, thermique

  • Assembler, câbler et réaliser les premiers tests d'intégration pour valider le fonctionnement des prototypes

  • Configurer et paramétrer les systèmes via Mission Planner (calibrations, paramètres, check avant vols)

Essais et documentation (5%)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : tests au banc, tests au sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Documenter les conceptions, les choix techniques et les résultats d'essais

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement de ses travaux à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

  • Étudiant(e) de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, licence professionnelle, master) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique, mécatronique ou équivalent

Compétences techniques

  • Très bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion

  • Notions de résistance des matériaux, de tolérancement et de choix des matériaux (PLA, PETG, ASA, nylon, composites chargés)

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, alimentation et puissance, dimensionnement de composants, soudure et câblage

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4) est un gros plus

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices) est un plus

Qualités personnelles

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
description: Mission Integral was founded in October 2024 by Lukas Zörner and Anil Can Baykal and is one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll and tax for European SMEs, starting with Germany. We're backed by General Catalyst, Cherry Ventures, Puzzle Ventures and entrepreneurs from across Europe. We're currently just over 50 people and hiring in two very different markets. On one side, tax advisors, certified accountants and payroll accountants, who are in demand nationwide and have to be won over from secure, permanent roles. On the other, AI engineers, product builders and GTM profiles, where the strongest companies in Berlin are competing for the same people. As Talent Acquisition Manager, you own these roles and take them from start to finish, from the intake with the team to the signed offer. You're the first hire in the Talent team, so very little is set in stone yet and a lot is yours to decide. Core Responsibilities Own your vacancies across the full cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, interview loop, debrief, offer and close. Source actively. It's a big part of the role. You identify the profiles we're looking for, reach out directly and convince them to make a move they hadn't been thinking about. Research, longlists and outreach are yours. Own the inbound side. You handle incoming applications, from review through first calls to the final response. Most of the volume arrives in the first few days after a role goes live and whoever responds fastest has the best conversations first. Partner closely with hiring managers. Sharpen the role profile together before the first review, agree on evaluation criteria up front and run the debriefs. Where an interview loop could work better, you propose changes and put them in place. Decide how we measure recruiting. You help decide which numbers we need, collect them and report on them regularly. When a search isn't working, you flag it early and can explain why. Own our Ashby setup for your roles, from pipeline hygiene through templates and interview guides to reporting. Keep the process at the pace we promise. Our job ads say under two weeks and candidates rely on it. What we're not looking for People who wait for a briefing before they start. Anyone who sees recruiting mainly as forwarding CVs. We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we're building the world's largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it. The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension. With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector. Infinite Orbits is looking for the founding team for its Munich site. Candidates who bring entrepreneurial drive, thrive in ambiguity, want ownership over what they build, and want to make a real difference in space are invited to explore the open positions on the company's website. Job Description About the Role As Satellite Systems Engineer, you own the spacecraft. You turn the agreed mission concept into a buildable, verifiable spacecraft solution covering platform, payload, and their interfaces, drawing on the Infinite Orbits Group's platforms and on German suppliers and partners. Proposal preparation is a core part of this role: you author the spacecraft design sections of Infinite Orbits Germany's bids, RFI/RFP responses, and funding applications. You substantiate sizing, heritage, and maturity, consolidate supplier input, and make sure that what we offer can be built, verified, and delivered within the cost and schedule we commit to. You work hand in hand with the Mission Systems Engineer, who owns the mission concept, and the Proposal & Project Manager, who runs the proposal process. Once contracts are won, you carry the spacecraft design through reviews, verification, and integration, and you help build up spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Munich as our German hardware content grows. Spacecraft proposal content: Author the spacecraft design sections of RFI/RFP responses, customer proposals, and national and European funding applications, covering configuration, subsystem and payload selection, spacecraft budgets, heritage and maturity (TRL) justification, compliance, and technical risks. Cost & schedule input for bids: Provide the Proposal & Project Manager with the technical basis for proposal cost and schedule, including make-or-buy decisions, supplier selection, procurement lead times, and verification and integration effort. Supplier & partner input: Request, assess, and consolidate technical offers from suppliers and partners into a coherent proposal baseline. Spacecraft requirements & budgets: Own spacecraft-level requirements derived from the mission baseline and manage spacecraft budgets (mass, power, thermal, link, pointing, propellant) through design and delivery. Interfaces & integration: Define and manage platform, payload, and subsystem interfaces (ICDs), including the integration of payloads and subsystems from German partners. Design reviews & verification: Prepare spacecraft design reviews and own verification and test planning at spacecraft level. Project execution: Own spacecraft engineering workstreams on won contracts, ensuring delivery against technical and contractual requirements. Group coordination: Work closely with platform engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities to reuse existing designs and keep the spacecraft baseline consistent across the Group. Capability build-up: Support the build-up of spacecraft integration and verification capability in Germany as the German hardware share grows. Requirements Education & Experience Engineering degree in aerospace, space systems engineering, or a related field, or equivalent. 3+ years of experience in spacecraft systems engineering, ideally at platform, prime, or integrator level. Experience contributing spacecraft design, cost, or schedule content to technical proposals in the space or defense sector. Experience with spacecraft integration, verification, or AIT is a plus. Skills & Other Requirements Strong command of spacecraft subsystems and their interactions (AOCS/GNC, power, thermal, propulsion, communications, structures, data handling). Working knowledge of ECSS standards and spacecraft verification approaches. Ability to size and defend spacecraft solutions, including heritage and maturity claims, under customer or stakeholder scrutiny. Excellent structured writing: able to turn design work into clear, compliant proposal content under deadline pressure. Experience working with suppliers and partners on technical offers and interface definitions. Autonomy and ownership: comfortable owning workstreams independently in an early-stage, cross-border team environment, working closely with Group entities in France and beyond. Fluent in German and English. Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations. What we offer A founding technical role with direct ownership of spacecraft design and proposal content in a growing European space and defense company. title: R&D and Innovation Manager (m/w/d), Space & Defense Industry
description: Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore. The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension. With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector. Tasks As R&D and Innovation Manager, you own Infinite Orbits Germany's research and innovation agenda in sensing and autonomy technologies, spanning RF, optical, and robotics hardware as well as the data postprocessing and object detection software that turns their output into mission value. We are hiring two R&D and Innovation Managers with complementary profiles: one with a focus on robotics and GNC, and one with a focus on sensing (RF and optical) and data processing. Beyond driving R&D in Germany, you help push product development for the wider Infinite Orbits Group, feeding German engineering excellence and technology access directly into the Group's product roadmap. You identify technology opportunities relevant to the German and European market, build the company's university and research-institution network, and secure non-dilutive funding to support technology maturation. You are a primary driver of Infinite Orbits' presence in the German innovation ecosystem, working closely with the engineering team to align research priorities with the company's technical roadmap and with Group entities to leverage existing technology developments. R&D agenda ownership: Define and drive the German R&D roadmap across sensing and autonomy technologies (RF, optical, robotics, data postprocessing, and object detection), identifying gaps and opportunities that strengthen Infinite Orbits' competitive and technical positioning. Group product development contribution: Feed German technology developments, research partnerships, and engineering excellence into the wider Infinite Orbits Group's product roadmap, ensuring German innovation strengthens the Group's overall offering. University & research partnerships: Own and grow relationships with German universities and research institutions active in these fields; identify and structure collaboration, thesis, and joint-research opportunities. Funding program ownership: Identify, pursue, and own applications to national and European funding programs for technology development, from scoping through submission and reporting, with the Proposal & Project Manager running the proposal process. Technology scouting: Track emerging RF, optical, robotics, data postprocessing, and object detection technologies and potential partners or suppliers relevant to RPO and in-orbit servicing, assessing fit with Infinite Orbits' roadmap. Group coordination: Work with Engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities to align German R&D activities in these areas with the broader Group technology roadmap and avoid duplication of effort. Stakeholder engagement: Represent Infinite Orbits at innovation-focused events, university engagements, and research consortia relevant to sensing and autonomy technology in the German space and defense sector. Requirements Education & Experience Engineering or scientific degree, or equivalent, in a field relevant to RF systems, optical systems, robotics, GNC, or software/data processing; PhD or strong research background a plus. 3+ years of experience in R&D management, innovation management, or research collaboration in sensing or autonomy technology, ideally in the space, defense, or deep-tech sector. Track record of securing and managing publicly funded R&D projects (national or EU level) is a strong plus. Skills & Other Requirements Working technical understanding of sensing and autonomy technologies as applied to space or in-orbit servicing missions (RF systems, optical sensing/communication, robotics, data postprocessing, and object detection). Deep expertise in one or two of these areas is expected; working literacy in the others is sufficient. Strong network-building ability with universities, research institutions, and innovation ecosystems across these technology domains. Solid understanding of funding program structures and application processes. Comfortable owning a new function independently in an early-stage, cross-border team environment. Fluent in German and English. Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations. Benefits A founding role shaping Infinite Orbits Germany's R&D and innovation strategy in sensing and autonomy technologies from the ground up, with direct influence on the wider Group's product roadmap. Direct exposure to Germany's university, research, and innovation-funding ecosystem in the space and defense sector. We are looking forward to your application! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Role: Director of Social & Creator – Dove Social Studios

Location: London (Global remit), 2–3 days per week

The Opportunity:

The role is on the Dove Social Studio, an always-on content & social engine spanning 15 markets. It drives social-first excellence for one of the world's most iconic, purposeful brands, connecting Dove's values with audiences through culture, creativity & community. 

This is an opportunity to shape how Dove connects with millions of people globally & define best-in-class social for both the brand & the industry. 

About the role: 

As Director of Social & Creators, you will set the global standard for how Dove shows up on social & inspire a multi-market team to continually raise the bar. 

Sitting on the client Global Leadership Team, you'll define how one of the world's most iconic brands shows up on social — and lead the multi-market team that delivers it. You'll oversee social media managers, creator leads, and senior social experts across markets, building capability, setting standards, and driving a programme that is native to platform, culture, and audience. As the senior social adviser to the client's global team, you'll translate platform expertise into confident, clear strategic direction.

What you will be doing: 

Social Platform Leadership

  • Define global social frameworks, standards, and best practice across client Social Studios
  • Identify platform opportunities, cultural moments, and emerging formats — and translate them into clear strategic action
  • Act as the studio's social authority, championing platform-native thinking across creative and content output

Creator & Influencer Strategy

  • Own the client's end-to-end creator and influence programme — from strategy design through to delivery
  • Evolve the programme in line with audience behaviour, platform developments, and brand values
  • Oversee creator managers and a large UGC network, maintaining creative quality, brand alignment, and scalable delivery
  • Coordinate creator activity across markets and ensure consistent use of the Creator Bench

Team Leadership & Capability

  • Lead and develop a global, multi-disciplinary team of social media managers, creator managers, and senior social experts
  • Set clear objectives and build a culture of curiosity, craft, and continuous improvement
  • Coach talent at all levels; create visible pathways for professional growth

Client Partnership

  • Serve as the primary social-craft partner to senior client stakeholders globally
  • Translate platform expertise and audience insight into strategic counsel, platform reviews, and brand presentations
  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, operating credibly at global marketing director level and above

Content & Campaign Planning

  • Put social insight, audience behaviour, and platform understanding at the centre of content and campaign planning
  • Set community management standards that consistently reflect the client's voice, values, and purpose

Commercial & Budget Accountability

  • Oversee studio-level and creator programme budgets; present financial performance to client and OLIVER senior stakeholders
  • Drive cost-effective delivery across a multi-market creator ecosystem — balancing quality, scale, and commercial health
  • Accountable for the financial health of the social and creator discipline within the studio

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Extensive social media leadership experience in a large brand, agency or hybrid environment, working across multiple markets 
  • Deep expertise across major & emerging social platforms, with a strong understanding of the evolving landscape 
  • Proven experience leading creator strategy & managing large creator ecosystems 
  • Strong people leadership & senior client skills, with the credibility to operate at the highest levels 
  • Operational rigour & the ability to bring clarity to complex, multi-market programmes 

Gen AI & Agentic Thinking 

  • Use Gen AI tools to improve ideation, listening, trend detection, creator sourcing & community workflows without compromising craft 
  • Set quality standards, brand-safety guardrails & best practice for responsible AI use 
  • Critically assess AI-generated work for cultural nuance, brand fit & human judgement 
  • Build AI literacy across teams & explain its role credibly to clients & senior stakeholders

You will work alongside brilliant, driven people who care deeply about the work, the brand & each other, with the freedom to define best-in-class social for one of the world's most loved brands.

title: Solutions Architect - EMEA
description:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Solutions Architect at Endor Labs, you're at the heart of connecting our innovative team with our diverse and dynamic customers. Every day presents a new set of exciting challenges and opportunities to make a significant impact:

  • Educate with Enthusiasm: Elevate awareness about Application Security and Software Supply Chain Security. It's about making security engaging and accessible to developers everywhere.
  • Master Our Tech: Deep dive into our supply chain security product suite and emerge as the go-to expert and evangelist.
  • Deliver Tailored Demos: Showcase our solutions in a way that speaks directly to the needs and challenges of our customers. Be the architect of captivating, solution-oriented presentations.
  • Shape Customer Outcomes: Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to design solutions that genuinely address customer challenges. Your insights from the field will directly influence our product development, ensuring we always meet our customers' evolving needs.
  • Facilitate Customer Success: Guide customers through onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition and adoption of the Endor Labs solution. Your goal is to empower customers to leverage our technology fully and ensure they achieve their security and development objectives.

What You Bring to the Table

We're on the hunt for someone who is not just looking for a job but likes a bit of adventure, too! You'll fit right in if you have:

  • Rich Experience: You have experience in pre-sales or a similar customer-facing, technical role. You're no stranger to technical deep dives, product demonstrations, and leading evaluations.
  • Strong Technical Foundation: A solid understanding of modern software development practices, including backend or full-stack development experience, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based development workflows, and DevOps tooling. You’re comfortable engaging deeply with engineering teams and understanding how modern applications are built and deployed.
  • Application Security Awareness: Familiarity with application security concepts, software supply chain security, and/or identity & access management principles. You understand the importance of securing developer workflows and modern cloud-native environments.
  • Tech Savvy: A robust understanding of the Developer, DevOps, Application Security, and open-source ecosystems. Hopefully, you can meet developers where they are and flex some programming skills.
  • Customer & Sales Skills: You've successfully engaged with technical customers at an Enterprise level and know how to articulate complex solutions and operate in a sales cycle.
  • Curious and Eager to Learn: Always on the lookout for new technologies and understanding the intricacies of how things work.
  • Collaborative Spirit: You thrive in a team setting and value diversity and inclusion in every interaction.
  • Action-oriented: You prefer actively solving customer problems and asking for help as needed.

What Makes Us... Us

  • Go to extraordinary lengths to distinguish ourselves through world-class work.
  • Prioritize quality over speed, and speed over scope.
  • Desire to work with deeply kind, mission-driven people.
  • Strive to make the complex simple.
  • Use first principles to debate ideas, test assumptions, and make decisions.
  • Seek the truth by putting data above opinions.
  • Assume good intent and give tactical feedback to help each other get better.
  • Hold no ego—when our customers win, we all win.

What We Offer You

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision and Mental Health plans. 
  • 401(k) plan to support your longterm financial goals.
  • Flexible PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance (we want you here for the long-haul!)
  • Opportunities for co-working and team meetups to foster collaboration.
  • A dog-friendly office environment for those who love to bring their fur babies along.

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

Compensation: For candidates who receive an offer for this position, the compensation range is expected to be between $190,000 - $250,000. This may include additional incentives such as commission targets, restricted stock units, and/or bonuses, depending on the role.

description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

 

Senior Associate – Sustainable Finance
Location: London or Kenya
Contract: 12-month FTC
Team / Platform: Sustainable Finance
Reporting to: Sustainable Finance leadership

About the role

SYSTEMIQ is looking for a Senior Associate to join our growing Sustainable Finance practice, focused on public and development finance. You will work with governments and public finance institutions to strengthen financing strategies and mobilise capital for climate, nature and development priorities.

This is a strategy advisory role, working in small, collaborative teams on complex advisory engagements and multi-stakeholder initiatives spanning governments, IFIs/DFIs, bilateral donors and the private sector. As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role in shaping and leading workstreams, developing client-ready analysis and materials, managing stakeholder relationships, and contributing to the growth of SYSTEMIQ’s sustainable finance work in Kenya and the wider region.

This role blends macro-level strategic thinking with strong research and analytical skills, excellent stakeholder engagement and communication, and the ability to deliver high-quality outputs in fast-moving, stakeholder-heavy contexts. Strategy consulting experience is welcome but not essential.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and support workstreams delivering high-quality advisory support on public and development finance for climate and nature outcomes.
  • Develop structured analysis and synthesise complex information into client-ready outputs, including strategy decks, technical notes, briefing packs and recommendations.
  • Drive work on sovereign financing strategies, including consideration of macroeconomic context, sovereign risk, debt sustainability and credit dynamics.
  • Help design, shape and assess financing approaches and instruments, including concessional and blended finance, sustainability-linked bonds/loans, debt-for-climate/nature swaps, and risk-sharing structures.
  • Manage and support stakeholder engagement across ministries, debt management offices, central banks, IFIs/DFIs, donors and private sector partners, including workshops and convenings.
  • Provide strategic insight and practical recommendations to support successful financing strategies and implementation pathways.
  • Contribute to proposal development, thought leadership and knowledge building within the Sustainable Finance team.
  • Support and mentor more junior team members, contributing to a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing team culture.

Mindset, skills & experience

We are seeking candidates who can demonstrate a strong commitment to SYSTEMIQ’s mission and a passion for systems change.

Essential

  • Master’s degree or equivalent experience in economics, finance, international development, public policy or a related field.
  • Typically 4+ years of relevant experience, for example in:
    • strategy consulting, ideally with exposure to sustainable finance;
    • international financial institutions such as the IMF, World Bank or AfDB;
    • central banks, debt management offices, finance ministries or public finance institutions;
    • credit rating agencies;
    • sovereign research or strategy teams;
    • development finance or advisory roles with strong sovereign finance exposure.
  • Strong familiarity with the sovereign financing landscape, including concessional finance, blended finance and/or climate and nature finance instruments such as sustainability-linked bonds/loans and debt-for-climate/nature swaps.
  • Strong understanding of macroeconomic context, sovereign risk, debt sustainability and credit dynamics.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical and research skills, with the ability to synthesise complex material into clear, structured and actionable outputs.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, including excellent written and verbal English.
  • Demonstrated stakeholder engagement skills, ideally in government-facing or multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong project discipline and ability to deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive and adaptable mindset, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive work forward.
  • Collaborative team player with strong mission alignment and willingness to support others.

Desirable

  • Formal study in economics, with a focus on macroeconomics, development economics, climate economics and/or nature economics.
  • Exposure to public-sector policy or planning, for example within finance ministries, environment ministries, or IFIs/DFIs.
  • Experience supporting stakeholder consultations, convenings or government-facing processes

Candidate profile

You are mission-driven and excited by the opportunity to help governments and financial institutions mobilise financing for climate and nature outcomes. You combine intellectual rigour with pragmatism and strong relationship skills. You are comfortable leading workstreams, structuring complex problems, engaging senior stakeholders and supporting junior colleagues.

You thrive in small teams, enjoy working across disciplines and stakeholder groups, and want your work to influence real-world decisions.

You will also align naturally with our values: Creativity, Challenge, Collaborate, Change and Care.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SYSTEMIQ, we believe that diversity and inclusion are crucial to system change and our mission. We are committed to embedding diverse and inclusive practices in all aspects of our work, including recruitment, performance management, people processes and policies.

We aim to provide a supportive environment where everyone can be themselves and perform at their best, regardless of background, personality, gender, sexual orientation, race, mental health, religion or other characteristics.

Additional information

Only applications from candidates legally eligible to work in Kenya or UK will be considered.

Visa sponsorship and relocation costs will not be provided.

The remuneration and benefits package will reflect the successful candidate’s experience and expertise.

Diversity & Inclusion
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.
