title: Director -Power Systems and Grid transformation
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation

Location: Amsterdam ( preferred), or London
Reports to: Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead
Role type: Full-time

Role Overview

Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.

This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.

This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.

This is a senior leadership role combining:

  • Deep power systems expertise
  • Top-tier strategy problem solving
  • Origination and senior client leadership
  • Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes
  • Team leadership and platform-building

You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.

Key Responsibilities

Power Systems & Grid Transformation

  • Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.
  • Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.
  • Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.
  • Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.

Strategic Advisory

  • Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.
  • Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.
  • Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.

Systems Change & Platform Leadership

  • Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.
  • Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.
  • Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.
  • Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.

Origination & Growth

  • Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor high-performing teams.
  • Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.

Essential Experience

  • Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy
  • Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory
  • Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.
  • Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.
  • Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.
  • Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.
  • Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.

Core Capabilities

  • Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.
  • Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.
  • Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.
  • Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.
  • Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency.
  • Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.

Mindset

  • Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work.
  • Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven.
  • Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact.

Why This Role Matters

Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today.

This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required.

Seit 1957 sind wir Vorreiter in den Bereichen Design, Engineering und Projektmanagement. title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

About the role

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.
  • Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.
  • Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.
  • Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.
  • Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.
  • Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.
  • Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.
  • Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.
  • Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.
  • Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of:

  • HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.
  • HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.
  • JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.
  • Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.
  • Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.
  • txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.
  • Structured data and Schema.org.
  • Core Web Vitals and web performance.
  • International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.
  • Website and platform migrations.
  • Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

  • Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.
  • Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.
  • Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.
  • Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.
  • Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.
  • Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.
  • Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.

Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.

What you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.
  • Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.
  • Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.
  • Strong experience working with large and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.
  • Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.
  • A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.
  • An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.
  • Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.

What we offer: 

We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. 
 
Our compensation: 

  • A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.
  • Hybrid working flexibility.
  • Access to learning platforms .
  • Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. 
  • Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. 
  • Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. 
  • At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth. 

 

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

Why Join Us?

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

About the Team

Our Perception and AI team is responsible for how STARK's unmanned systems perceive their surroundings and know where they are. We are a multidisciplinary group of software and navigation engineers developing perception and navigation algorithms for resource-constrained platforms. As a member of this team, you will collaborate closely with sensor, autonomy and test engineers in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. Together, we make sure our systems navigate and operate reliably in contested environments, even when GNSS is not available.

Your Mission

As a Senior Radar Signal Processing Engineer at STARK, you will lead the development of our radar processing chain: turning raw sensor data into reliable 3D detections, in real time, on embedded hardware. Your ultimate goal is to deliver radar measurements that our navigation and mapping algorithms can depend on in the most demanding conditions.

Responsibilities

- Design and implement the full radar processing chain: range-Doppler processing, angle estimation and detection.
- Develop robust clutter suppression, multipath mitigation and detection methods for changing terrain, vegetation and weather.
- Deliver 3D detections with Doppler and quality metrics, and define the measurement interface with our radar navigation engineers.
- Evaluate radar sensors with our sensors team and integrate your work with embedded software, autonomy and test teams.
- Take algorithms from Python/MATLAB prototypes to production C++ on embedded compute, and analyse field data to characterise performance and failure modes.
- Constantly challenge requirements and take ownership of radar signal processing as a capability at STARK.

What We Are Looking For

- You have taken a radar processing chain from raw ADC data to detections on real hardware, not only in simulation.
- Deep understanding of radar signal processing â€” range-Doppler processing, direction-of-arrival estimation, detection theory, clutter â€” and of the underlying radar physics.
- Strong C++ for real-time systems; Python or MATLAB for prototyping and analysis.
- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Physics or a comparable field.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.
- Citizenship of a NATO member state.

Nice to Have

- MIMO radar and array processing
- Radar on moving platforms, including ego-motion compensation
- Embedded acceleration (GPU, SIMD, FPGA)
- Learning-based radar detection or classification
- ROS2 and experience with field testing

Relevant Backgrounds

Deep expertise in radar signal processing matters more to us than meeting every single requirement. You might come from automotive radar and ADAS, aerospace or defence radar, telecommunications and SDR, or academic radar research.

Why STARK

- Impact: Your work directly strengthens the autonomy of STARK systems and the technological edge of European defence.
- Innovation: Work in a builder culture where you take radar sensing from first concept to field deployment.
- Growth: Shape how STARK uses radar from the ground up and grow with the capability.
- Collaboration: Join a multi-national team of navigation, perception, radar and test engineers where practical solutions count.

Equal Opportunity:

At Stark Defence, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team. We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

If you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications—ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. We value unique perspectives, adaptability, and a drive to solve high-stakes challenges.

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

title: Head of Go-to-Market, AI Care Operations
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

 

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

 

AI Care Operations (previously Sword Intelligence), is Sword's AI care management division. We don't deliver a clinical program to members. We deploy AI Care Managers, trained on more than 14 million real care interactions, to run the operations of providers, payers and national health systems.

It started as an internal problem. On the way to freeing over a million people from pain, Sword hit the same wall every healthcare organization does: we didn't have enough hands to scale the care we needed to provide. Instead of hiring our way out, we built AI to do it, certified it for clinical use, and ran it in our own operations before offering it to anyone else.

Today we sell two families of solutions:

  • Triage — a certified Clinical Triage Line that guides every patient to the right care, 24/7, across voice and digital channels.
  • Care Orchestration — care navigation, population health campaigns (screenings, vaccinations, medication adherence), surgery prehab and rehab, and readmission prevention.

We've announced a partnership with the Hellenic Ministry of Health to build an AI-powered front door for Greece's 10 million citizens, and we work with other national health systems, health plans and providers across the US and Europe. The US is now our biggest growth opportunity, and this role is central to capturing it.

The role

We are hiring a Head of Go-to-Market for AI Care Operations in the US. The role sits at the intersection of product marketing, competitive intelligence and commercial enablement. It is one of the leadership roles on the AI Care Operations team, reporting to the General Manager.

Here's the opportunity. "AI agents for healthcare" is one of the most crowded categories in the market right now. Voice AI startups, EHR vendors, care management platforms and outsourcers all claim to automate care operations, and to a buyer they can sound alike. Very few of them have certified medical devices, national-scale partnerships, or AI proven on hundreds of thousands of their own members before it was sold to anyone else. We have all three. Your job is to make that difference unmistakable.

You will own three things:

  1. Make our value impossible to miss. Build the narrative, positioning and competitive differentiation that make it obvious why AI Care Operations is categorically better than AI point solutions, legacy nurse lines and call centers, and the care management platforms buyers already have. That means the core messaging architecture across Triage and Care Orchestration, positioning by buyer (health plan, health system, value-based care, employer, government), battle cards, ROI frameworks, and the demos and proof that move a skeptical COO or VP of Care Management.
  2. Make sure the commercial team can tell that story. Sword's segment sales teams sell many solutions and can't be experts in all of them. When the health plan team is in front of a Medicare Advantage plan, or the employer team is pitching a front door for a self-insured population, they come to you to scope the workflows, walk the buyer through how the agents actually work, and answer the hard questions on safety, integration and ROI.
  3. Find, surface and pursue the opportunities. You will canvass the US and international markets systematically for the accounts, RFPs, procurements, contract renewals and budget signals that would otherwise go unnoticed: a health plan rebuilding its care management operation, a health system under readmission penalties, a state agency tendering a nurse line. You'll use AI tooling to do this faster and wider than a traditional GTM team could, then partner with the relevant segment leader to make sure each opportunity is pursued and won.

AI proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword, and every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework: Explorer (uses AI daily for personal productivity), Builder (creates workflows and tools that lift the whole team) and Integrator (embeds AI into products and processes at scale). This role requires Builder at minimum. Come ready with real examples.

What you'll be doing

  • Core positioning, messaging house and narrative architecture for AI Care Operations and each of its solutions
  • The category story: why AI care management that does the work beats both headcount and AI tools that only assist the people doing it
  • Competitive intelligence and battle cards across voice AI and agentic AI vendors, nurse line and call center outsourcers, and care management platforms
  • Buyer-facing materials: one-pagers, ROI and capacity calculators, demo scripts and recorded agent calls, case studies, RFP response library, sales decks
  • Proof architecture: turning deployments into case studies and outcome metrics (contacts handled, cost per interaction, gap closure, time to care, readmissions) that a CFO will sign off on
  • Solution specialist team (direct reports), paired with segment sales reps across health plans, health systems, value-based care, employers and government
  • Sales and customer success enablement: training, playbooks, discovery guides, certification on each solution
  • Market opportunity mapping and systematic canvassing across US segments, with a lighter watch on international tenders
  • Message consistency across Sword's commercial segments and geographies, including where AI Care Operations is sold as part of the broader AI Care platform
  • Voice of the market into product: what buyers ask for, where we lose, and what competitors are shipping

We'd love to see

You are currently at, or recently from, a Lead, Head, Director or VP-level GTM or product marketing role where you owned the full stack: launching products, positioning, competitive differentiation, sales enablement and market strategy. You've built things that measurably changed how deals were won.

You can sell something that isn't a product category yet. AI Care Operations is bought by operations leaders, not benefits leaders, and it competes with a budget line (headcount, outsourcing) as much as with other vendors. You know how to make the case that replacing work is different from adding a tool, and you can tell a clean story across several solutions without it sounding like a platform pitch that means nothing.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location:

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

About the role:

As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security.

  • Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security.

  • Oversight of the IT function

  • Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales.

  • Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation.

  • Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event.

  • Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels.

  • Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably.

  • Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence.

What Success Looks Like:

First 30 Days

  • You've built a clear, independent picture of Morpho's posture, architecture, threat model, and in-flight work - and pressure-tested the existing strategy against it.

  • You've met the team and established working relationships with the people who own the surfaces you'll most depend on.

  • You understand the path-to-funds attack surface in depth and have an early, evidence-based view of the highest-severity risks and quick wins.

  • You know exactly where incident-response readiness stands today.

First 60 Days

  • You've published a clearly prioritized security roadmap with clear sequencing, owners, and the rationale for what's deferred and aligned leadership behind it.

  • You've defined the team build-out plan and opened the first hire.

  • You're personally driving the top-severity gaps - identity and authentication enforcement, deployment guardrails, and a documented incident-response runbook among them.

  • You've set the governance framework and the certification path in motion.

First 90 Days

  • Demonstrable progress closing the highest-priority gaps, with key controls enforced rather than optional.

  • A documented incident-response capability that's been validated by at least one tabletop exercise.

  • Hiring underway, and a clear operating rhythm established with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations.

  • Morpho's external security posture is taking shape - trust surface, counterparty security program, and ecosystem engagement - and you're recognized internally and externally as Morpho's credible security voice.

Must-have Experience & Skills:

  • 10+ years in security, several of them building or leading a security function, ideally at a crypto/web3, fintech, or financial-services company where security is core to the business.

  • Strong grasp of the crypto/web3 threat model

  • Proven experience building and growing a security team from a small base, recruiting across security operations and application/infrastructure security.

  • Deep, hands-on technical expertise across cloud, infrastructure, CI/CD, supply-chain, identity, and application security - you do the work, not just direct it.

  • Owned incident response end to end, including incident command and external communication.

  • Sharp prioritization and the ability to galvanize action through hard and soft influence, including driving outcomes through teams you don't own.

  • Exceptional, organized, responsive communication - credible to executives and to external audiences from fintechs to Fortune 500 institutions.

  • Humble.

Nice to Have:

  • An established network and public profile in the security or crypto-security community, and comfort representing security work publicly (talks, writing, framework contribution).

  • Offensive security depth, or experience standing up red/blue capabilities.

  • Familiarity with institutional and regulatory expectations and threat-sharing networks (e.g. Crypto ISAC, TIBER-style frameworks).

  • Taken an organization through certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent)

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Sunday is a next-generation hybrid casual mobile game publisher. And justtrack offers unique software to automate the entire mobile user acquisition process. Yet more to come. By developing a state-of-the-art tech stack and highly skilled workforce, we aim to reach more mobile users than any other company in the world. Find the whole world in one office. Boost your career with awesome people! Managerial Consultation: Consult managers on the full employee lifecycle, proactive performance management and labor law matters, ensuring the right balance HR excellence and using a pragmatic approach in every step. Performance Enablement: Upskill managers on early-stage performance management, considering legal compliance but also high-speed, pragmatic, tactical support to minimize business disruption. Education: University degree in Business Administration, HR Management, Psychology, Law, or a completed relevant apprenticeship. Labor Law Expertise: Strong, tested knowledge of German/International labor law, and modern employee management practices. Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of successfully advising, challenging, and building trust with) business leads across various hierarchical levels. Lifecycle & Global Mobility: Profound experience in full HR lifecycle management, including dealing with international relocation and immigration cases, as well as EOR services. Tech & Tool Savviness: High proficiency in modern HRIS platforms (e.g., Personio, Workday) and digital collaboration tools. Future-Proof Mindset & AI Literacy: A strong intrinsic interest in emerging technologies and a proactive mindset toward leveraging AI tools and their integration to automate routines, optimize workflows, and continuously elevate role efficiency. Working Style: Analytical yet empathetic mindset; highly structured & solution-oriented working style; integrity champion & confidentiality preserver, and exceptional communication skills. Languages: Fluent in English (C1 level) and German (B1/B2) to confidently handle local as well as international legal cases and stakeholder collaboration. We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home. Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond : We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Thrive Where You Work : Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks. Join the Community! title: Engineering Intern
description: About Atira Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP. We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us! Why engineers are the foundation of everything Atira ships As an Engineering Intern at Atira, you will work on frontier AI technology, such as (recursive) agent harnesses, runtimes, evals, inference and self-verification in complex engineering domains. You build the frameworks, primitives and scaffolding that let agents reliably handle complex industrial processes end to end, from the first inbound RFQ to the write-back into ERP. Misreading or wrongly interpreting a spec can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the challenges are real and the margin for error is thin. Where you trained matters less than what you've built and how clearly you can describe what broke. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow. What you will do Work on the agent runtime and harnesses. You improve the core components that let Atira's agents reason in complex engineering environments across the entire sales-engineering lifecycle, orchestrate themselves recursively at scale through dynamic programs, and handle arbitrarily large amounts of data. This includes the runtime/sandboxing, the harness, and the outer orchestration layer that ties it together Build out our AI moat. You are in charge of improving quality & evals, improving the ontology layer that unlocks compounding process knowledge and fusing deterministic guardrails with agentic agency to make our agents actionable at enterprise level complexity Unlock industrial scale. Industrials live in multi-modal, data-heavy environments: 1000-page inbounds, pricing lists, CAD files, ERP tables, legacy applications. You scale the AI systems behind them to millions of concurrent LLM requests in isolated sandboxes, with no silent failures, cost blowouts or latency explosions. Advance our internal tooling. FDEs, platform engineers and the GTM team depend on tooling you build to improve Atira's internal context layer, ambient agents, insight and observability engines Work with FDEs when customer problems hit the platform. When an FDE hits a problem they should be able to pull you in. At a team of 20, the boundary between AI, platform and customer is thin, and you'll cross it regularly What we are looking for Ownership, depth, and the instinct to take problems personally, go deep until you understand the system, and own the outcome including the parts that broke. Your profile Agent fluency sits on top of real engineering fundamentals. Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. We value someone that can still code without AI. Ideally paired with hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing and tools You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents. This isn't a nice-to-have. We think engineers who have mastered this are fundamentally more productive, and we hire accordingly You reason clearly about technical tradeoffs. You don’t need to have run systems at scale yet, but you can think through how a design would hold up at thousands of requests per second and explain the pros and cons of different approaches. Every design has tradeoffs: no free lunch You’ve demonstrated ownership and initiative. A side project you took further than anyone asked, a serious open-source contribution, a research project or a startup. We want evidence that you build without being told to and can explain what broke and why You have a strong technical foundation. Enrolled or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field from a strong technical university (cracked dropouts can qualify too though) Full working proficiency in English. German is not required You're ready for a real internship, not a side gig. You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich What you'll get Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers Strong peers and mentorship: work with and learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale, with the opportunity for mentorship along the way Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide Competitive salary and additional benefits Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity What success looks like at the end of the internship You've shipped meaningful improvements to the agent runtime, our AI pipelines and related systems that are running in production across multiple customer deployments You own one well-defined piece of our AI stack end to end (an eval suite, an internal tool, part of the context layer or the SDK), and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve When something breaks in the part you own, you can trace it end to end, from agent behaviour back to the agent infrastructure layer, and fix it You’ve made an improvement to our internal AI tooling that the team now uses day to day The design decisions in your piece have held up under real load, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made and what you’d do differently If these metrics are met, we'd take you full-time without thinking twice Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why engineers are the foundation of everything Atira ships

As an Engineering Intern at Atira, you will work on frontier AI technology, such as (recursive) agent harnesses, runtimes, evals, inference and self-verification in complex engineering domains. You build the frameworks, primitives and scaffolding that let agents reliably handle complex industrial processes end to end, from the first inbound RFQ to the write-back into ERP.

Misreading or wrongly interpreting a spec can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the challenges are real and the margin for error is thin.

Where you trained matters less than what you've built and how clearly you can describe what broke. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow.

What you will do

  • Work on the agent runtime and harnesses. You improve the core components that let Atira's agents reason in complex engineering environments across the entire sales-engineering lifecycle, orchestrate themselves recursively at scale through dynamic programs, and handle arbitrarily large amounts of data. This includes the runtime/sandboxing, the harness, and the outer orchestration layer that ties it together

  • Build out our AI moat. You are in charge of improving quality & evals, improving the ontology layer that unlocks compounding process knowledge and fusing deterministic guardrails with agentic agency to make our agents actionable at enterprise level complexity

  • Unlock industrial scale. Industrials live in multi-modal, data-heavy environments: 1000-page inbounds, pricing lists, CAD files, ERP tables, legacy applications. You scale the AI systems behind them to millions of concurrent LLM requests in isolated sandboxes, with no silent failures, cost blowouts or latency explosions.

  • Advance our internal tooling. FDEs, platform engineers and the GTM team depend on tooling you build to improve Atira's internal context layer, ambient agents, insight and observability engines

  • Work with FDEs when customer problems hit the platform. When an FDE hits a problem they should be able to pull you in. At a team of 20, the boundary between AI, platform and customer is thin, and you'll cross it regularly

What we are looking for

Ownership, depth, and the instinct to take problems personally, go deep until you understand the system, and own the outcome including the parts that broke.

Your profile

  • Agent fluency sits on top of real engineering fundamentals. Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. We value someone that can still code without AI. Ideally paired with hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing and tools

  • You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents. This isn't a nice-to-have. We think engineers who have mastered this are fundamentally more productive, and we hire accordingly

  • You reason clearly about technical tradeoffs. You don’t need to have run systems at scale yet, but you can think through how a design would hold up at thousands of requests per second and explain the pros and cons of different approaches. Every design has tradeoffs: no free lunch

  • You’ve demonstrated ownership and initiative. A side project you took further than anyone asked, a serious open-source contribution, a research project or a startup. We want evidence that you build without being told to and can explain what broke and why

  • You have a strong technical foundation. Enrolled or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field from a strong technical university (cracked dropouts can qualify too though)

  • Full working proficiency in English. German is not required

  • You're ready for a real internship, not a side gig. You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers and mentorship: work with and learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale, with the opportunity for mentorship along the way

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary and additional benefits

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like at the end of the internship

  • You've shipped meaningful improvements to the agent runtime, our AI pipelines and related systems that are running in production across multiple customer deployments

  • You own one well-defined piece of our AI stack end to end (an eval suite, an internal tool, part of the context layer or the SDK), and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve

  • When something breaks in the part you own, you can trace it end to end, from agent behaviour back to the agent infrastructure layer, and fix it

  • You’ve made an improvement to our internal AI tooling that the team now uses day to day

  • The design decisions in your piece have held up under real load, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made and what you’d do differently

  • If these metrics are met, we'd take you full-time without thinking twice

title: Inside Enterprise Account Executive UK
description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. About the Role At Dandy, our Inside Account Executives (IAEs) drive sales at the practice level within Dental Support Organizations (DSOs). As an IAE, you are a strategic hunter who combines the high-velocity closing skills of a top-tier SMB/Mid-Market representative with the operational rigor and "big picture" focus needed as an enterprise seller to navigate corporate ambiguity. In this pivotal role and high visibility role, you will sell into the largest DSOs in the world, building and harvesting your territory. Success requires adapting to complex variables such as corporate nuances, preferred pricing, scanner types, and SKU focus all while maintaining a highly organized, detail-oriented book of business. What You'll Do: Execute Strategic Sales Motions: Navigate two distinct sales environments side-by-side to expand Dandy’s footprint: Post-MSA Expansion: Grow accounts to 70%+ penetration by selling to practices individually or in group settings. Partner with cross-functional teammates to lead and execute expansion tactics within DSOs that have a signed Master Service Agreement (MSA). Pre-MSA Groundswell: Sell to individual practices before a corporate MSA is signed to create grassroots momentum within the DSO. Act as a strategic scout to gather corporate intelligence, generate introductions to key stakeholders, and identify trends that help support corporate-level negotiations. Drive high-conversion sales with new practices, facilitate a seamless onboarding experience, and guide clients through to a successful first order. Share practice-level insights and trends with cross-functional teams to support high-level corporate conversations and cement Dandy as the number one lab within the DSO. Adopt a student mentality and learn the dental industry, become an expert on sharing the Dandy value proposition for this segment. What We're Looking For: 5+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years of closing experience. Prior experience with ground-floor AE ownership, expansion sales, or enterprise sales environments, along with a verified track record of strategic execution and quota overattainment. Strong sales acumen with a high close rate and the high-velocity closing skills required to push deals across the finish line. A self-starter who thrives on determination, grit, and cross-functional leadership, with a refusal to do the bare minimum just to hit a quota. Exceptional attention to detail with tight pipeline management and data discipline. The ability to "zoom out" to understand long-term corporate strategy while executing daily, ground-level sales. Flexibility to travel 30-40% as needed. Bonus Points For: Outstanding professional references to share Love of blitz growth environments Experience as an early-stage or expansion builder (e.g., being a first or early sales hire, helping define ICP/GTM, or building a territory from zero in ambiguous, fast-moving environments). Background in high-bar, outbound-driven tech or corporate environments known for world-class sales enablement and rigid, high-value processes. Direct experience selling into or navigating the dental industry or healthcare corporate structures (DSOs). For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work. Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus. Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position. International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus. Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable. Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things. AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition. Languages: Fluent French and English. 💎 Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through: Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget. Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year. On top of that, we offer plenty of perks: 💸 Top-market compensation 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent …and much more, check the full list here ! 🤝 Our hiring process Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams). Step 2 – Role-specific assessments For non-engineering roles : A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design). For engineering roles : A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool). Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers. ☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture. Coach your leaders on pipeline management, forecasting, deal inspection, rep development, and performance management. Hold them accountable for running their businesses with the same rigor you bring to yours. Scale Commercial across Europe. Determine where and when to add coverage as Zip expands into new countries and markets, and build the teams and leadership required to win locally without creating unnecessary complexity. Own pipeline well before the quarter begins. Establish coverage requirements, identify future gaps early, and work across Business Development, Marketing, Partnerships, and the AE organization to address them before they become revenue problems. Drive rigorous forecasting. Build a business that is predictable. Know what is real, what is at risk, what has changed, and why, and ensure your managers operate with the same level of precision. Stay close to the deals. Ensure your managers are inspecting opportunities rigorously, and personally engage in important customer conversations where executive involvement can improve discovery, create urgency, strengthen sponsorship, or move a deal forward. Build a high-performance organization. Recruit outstanding managers and sellers, raise the talent bar as we grow, develop top performers, and address underperformance quickly and directly. Improve the Commercial sales motion. Diagnose where performance is constrained by pipeline, execution, territory design, productivity, process, or capability and make the changes required to improve it. Operate cross-functionally. Build strong partnerships with Business Development, Solution Consulting, Advisory, Marketing, Partnerships, GTM Operations, Customer, and Zip's Executive team. Represent the Commercial business internally. Provide clear, credible reporting on performance, pipeline, forecast, market dynamics, competitive trends, and the investments required to continue scaling. Build for where Zip is going, not where it is today. Your Role

Zip is looking for a Senior Director of EMEA Commercial Sales to lead and scale our Commercial business across Europe.

This is a second-line leadership role. You will initially lead two frontline Commercial Sales Managers and, through them, a growing team of Account Executives. As Zip expands across Europe, you will build the leadership structure, sales capacity, and go-to-market approach required to capture that opportunity.

Your leverage comes through your managers, but this is not a role for someone who operates from a distance. You will stay close to the business: understanding the pipeline, inspecting deals, helping your managers improve their teams, and personally getting involved in the opportunities where your experience can change the outcome.

You will own the performance of EMEA Commercial end to end: the number, pipeline, forecast, talent, geographic expansion, and operating rhythm of the segment.

Commercial is already an important part of Zip's EMEA business. The opportunity now is to turn it into a scaled, predictable growth engine across the region.

You Will

  • Own EMEA Commercial performance. Deliver quarterly and annual new-business revenue targets through the frontline managers and Account Executives who report into your organization.

  • Build and develop exceptional frontline managers. Coach your leaders on pipeline management, forecasting, deal inspection, rep development, and performance management. Hold them accountable for running their businesses with the same rigor you bring to yours.

  • Scale Commercial across Europe. Determine where and when to add coverage as Zip expands into new countries and markets, and build the teams and leadership required to win locally without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Own pipeline well before the quarter begins. Establish coverage requirements, identify future gaps early, and work across Business Development, Marketing, Partnerships, and the AE organization to address them before they become revenue problems.

  • Drive rigorous forecasting. Build a business that is predictable. Know what is real, what is at risk, what has changed, and why, and ensure your managers operate with the same level of precision.

  • Stay close to the deals. Ensure your managers are inspecting opportunities rigorously, and personally engage in important customer conversations where executive involvement can improve discovery, create urgency, strengthen sponsorship, or move a deal forward.

  • Build a high-performance organization. Recruit outstanding managers and sellers, raise the talent bar as we grow, develop top performers, and address underperformance quickly and directly.

  • Improve the Commercial sales motion. Diagnose where performance is constrained by pipeline, execution, territory design, productivity, process, or capability and make the changes required to improve it.

  • Operate cross-functionally. Build strong partnerships with Business Development, Solution Consulting, Advisory, Marketing, Partnerships, GTM Operations, Customer, and Zip's Executive team.

  • Represent the Commercial business internally. Provide clear, credible reporting on performance, pipeline, forecast, market dynamics, competitive trends, and the investments required to continue scaling.

  • Build for where Zip is going, not where it is today. Create the leadership bench, operating model, and market coverage that will support a significantly larger EMEA Commercial organization over the next several years.

  • You are rigorous about pipeline creation and pipeline quality. You think several quarters ahead rather than discovering a pipeline problem once the quarter has begun.

  • You run a predictable business and have a strong track record of forecast accuracy and operational discipline.

  • You have built or expanded sales teams across multiple European markets and understand that what works in the UK does not automatically translate into Germany, France, Benelux, Nordics, or Southern Europe.

  • You have a track record of hiring and developing strong sales leaders and creating a bench of future leadership talent.

  • You are equally comfortable with high expectations and hands-on coaching. You give clear, actionable feedback and address problems early.

  • You operate well in a fast-growth environment where the organization, product, market, and playbook are all evolving quickly.

  • You have a strong executive presence and can build credibility with senior customer stakeholders while keeping the Account Executive and frontline manager at the center of the relationship.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including meaningful sales leadership experience.

  • 2+ years managing frontline sales managers or equivalent second-line leadership responsibility.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets through teams.

  • Demonstrated experience scaling sales organizations across territories, countries, or customer segments.

  • Strong experience with pipeline management, forecasting, sales process, territory design, productivity metrics, and performance management.

  • Experience hiring and developing both sales managers and Account Executives.

  • Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or enterprise technology company.

  • Experience selling through value-based, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Based in the UK and able to work from Zip's central London office three days per week.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience leading a high-velocity Commercial or mid-market SaaS organization.

title: Process Automation Engineer
description: Functieprofiel Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software). Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners. Bedrijfsomschrijving NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie. Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste. Wat ga jij doen! In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met: Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3) Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein Wat wij vragen! Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering: Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen Wat bieden wij jou! Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd. Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities. Wat ga je doen? Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden. title: Teamleider ICT & Security (m/v/x)
description: DNW zoekt een teamleider die ICT en security samenbrengt: iemand die zorgt dat onze medewerkers goed kunnen werken, onze systemen betrouwbaar beschikbaar zijn en onze informatie veilig blijft. Wat ga je doen? Je geeft leiding aan het team ICT & Security en bent verantwoordelijk voor de integrale aansturing van ICT en het organisatie brede security domein (Duitsland en Nederland). Je zorgt voor een samenhangende aanpak van fysieke beveiliging, informatiebeveiliging en IT-/cybersecurity in lijn met ISO 27001, wet- en regelgeving en de organisatiedoelstellingen. Op locaties Marknesse en Amsterdam levert je team lokale ICT ondersteuning. Op onze locaties in Duitsland wordt die lokale ondersteuning verzorgt binnen de lokale windtunnel teams waarmee doelmatig samengewerkt wordt. ICT binnen DNW omvat naast reguliere kantoortoepassingen ook een uitgebreid en complex netwerk van faciliteit gebonden meet- en regelsystemen en data-acquisitiesystemen die 24/7 operationeel moeten blijven. title: Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter
description: Bouw mee aan recruitment voor een hoogwaardige tech consultancy Senior tech professionals vinden vraagt meer dan vacatures publiceren en sollicitaties beoordelen. De beste kandidaten zijn vaak niet actief op zoek. Je moet weten waar je ze vindt, hoe je ze benadert en hoe je ze enthousiast maakt voor een inhoudelijk gesprek. Bij Conflux zoeken we daarom een Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter die recruitment en sourcing beheerst. Iemand die zelfstandig de arbeidsmarkt benadert, hiring managers adviseert en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het volledige recruitmentproces. Conflux is een Nederlandse tech consultancy met gespecialiseerde expertise binnen onder andere Data & AI, Software Development, Cloud en Platform Engineering. Onze consultants werken aan complexe technische vraagstukken en behoren inhoudelijk tot de ervaren professionals binnen hun vakgebied. Dat betekent dat onze recruitment vraagstukken niet eenvoudig zijn. We zoeken onder andere Senior Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Java Developers, Kubernetes Engineers, Platform Engineers en Front-end Developers. Daarvoor zoeken we een recruiter die zijn of haar vak verstaat. Wat je gaat doen Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de werving van ervaren technische consultants binnen onder andere: Data Engineering & AI Machine Learning Java Development Kubernetes & Cloud Native Cloud & Platform Engineering Front-end Development Je beheert het recruitmentproces van arbeidsmarktanalyse en sourcing tot selectie en aanbieding. Concreet betekent dit dat je: actief technische professionals sourcet en benadert, onder andere via LinkedIn Recruiter en andere sourcingkanalen; zelfstandig searches en sourcingstrategieën ontwikkelt voor moeilijk vindbare doelgroepen; kandidaten screent op ervaring, technische context, motivatie en consultancy-fit; hiring managers adviseert over doelgroep, haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, selectiecriteria en recruitmentaanpak; kandidaten gedurende het volledige proces begeleidt en zorgt voor een professionele en persoonlijke candidate experience; interview- en selectieprocessen bewaakt en waar nodig bijstuurt; talentpools opbouwt en relaties onderhoudt met relevante professionals; data en recruitmentinzichten gebruikt om keuzes en prioriteiten te onderbouwen; externe recruitmentpartners inzet wanneer dit aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt; kansen signaleert om recruitment slimmer, sneller en effectiever te organiseren. raw.title: Senior Azure Platform Engineer
raw.description:
Als Senior Azure Platform Engineer bij Conflux Consulting help je organisaties bij het ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van moderne cloud-native platformen op Microsoft Azure en Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Je opereert op het snijvlak van platform engineering, cloud, infrastructuur, Kubernetes en DevOps.


Je bent niet alleen uitvoerend sterk, maar ook inhoudelijk richtinggevend. Je adviseert klanten over platformarchitectuur, containerisatie, cloud governance, security, automation en schaalbaarheid. Je bouwt productieklare Azure- en AKS-platformen waarop development- en engineeringteams veilig, betrouwbaar en zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig kunnen werken.


Daarbij kijk je verder dan individuele Azure-services. Je denkt vanuit het platform als geheel: hoe standaardiseren en automatiseren we infrastructuur?
